0.original: Hremfing has a secret message for you.

1.original: It seems a young fellow named Wilred wants a word with you in private. Make your way to the designated meeting point, a rocky area north of the settlement.

2.original: Somewhat predictably, the rendezvous turns out to be a trap. Wilred and his cronies fall upon you, but you succeed in overpowering them. Question Wilred and learn of his agenda.

3.original: Wilred manages to give you the slip, but not before mentioning a plan to bring down the Empire. Gundobald will want to know of this.

4.original: Gundobald is troubled to learn that Wilred and his companions will stop at nothing for their plan. What could the young ones possibly mean to do?

48.original: Hey, adventurer. You done talking with the old bear?

49.original: I've got a message for you from Wilred. Lad's something of a leader among the young ones here.

50.original: He's impressed that you've won over Gundobald, and wants a word with you. Says he'll be waiting over at the craggy area north of here.

51.original: Thanks for coming, friend. 'Tis no ordinary outsider who can gain the trust of the old bear. That's why I wanted to meet you, to discuss something in private.

52.original: Tell me...why are you snooping about? Did the Empire send you? Or someone else?

53.original: Coeurl got your tongue? Hmph, no matter. Whoever it is you work for, your meddling ends here. Get <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>!

54.original: I won't let you foil our plan!

57.original: This changes nothing! Threaten us, beat us bloody all you like...but nothing short of death can make us give up our fight!

58.original: We're going to obtain the power to bring down the Empire, and with it we'll reclaim our homeland!

59.original: Attacked by Wilred and his cronies!? That they would go to such lengths for the sake of this plan of theirs...

60.original: Left to their own devices, the young fools are like to harm others, if not themselves. We must uncover their agenda and put an end to this madness.
